text: nice, can we get in the capability to paint the textures and see the entire textures menu from the workspace. so i dont have to travel back and forth so much, especially since inside of there i can only edit a prefab building but i can do all buildings from this pov
resolution: Brought the full textures menu into the PAINT workspace tab so the user stops bouncing to the Objects tab (which only skins one inspected prefab) to apply textures — the PAINT panel already paints onto any selected placed building, so it just needed the complete menu in reach. FacePainter now has: (1) a live search box that filters EVERY texture flat by label/id across shader recipes + building skins + Materialized customs, and (2) an 'all' group prepended to the family chips so the entire menu is one click to browse. Perf-conscious per the existing 'only the open group mounts live previews' guard: search renders only its hits, 'all' is opt-in and explicitly excluded from being the default open group, so a fresh open still lands on a small family rather than mounting ~87 live <Effect> previews at once. Bundle-check passes (esbuild exit 0).
